meta.name: game-retrospective
meta.description: Run a game development post-mortem rooted in the GDC tradition. Triggers on: "retrospective", "retro", "post-mortem", "lessons learned", "what went right", "what went wrong", "kill list review". Do NOT invoke for design document review (use game-design-review) or playtesting (use game-playtest). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 复盘游戏开发过程，总结得失与教训
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚完成一个游戏项目，想系统性地回顾经验教训。
copy.tagline_en: Run a game development post-mortem to review what went right and wrong.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just finished a game project and want to systematically review lessons learned.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你按游戏行业经典的事后复盘格式，分析一个开发阶段中哪些做对了、哪些做错了，并总结教训。
howto.when: 当你提到“回顾”、“事后分析”、“经验教训”等关键词，或要求对某个冲刺、里程碑或项目进行复盘时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一次这个冲刺的事后复盘。
say.note: Claude 会按 GDC 格式引导你分析做对和做错的事。

say.text: 分析一下我们砍掉的功能列表。
从核心循环验证的角度复盘这个里程碑。
say.note: Claude 会使用六个游戏开发透镜之一进行深度分析。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will guide you through a game development post-mortem in the classic GDC tradition, analyzing what went right, what went wrong, and lessons learned for a given sprint, milestone, or project.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "retrospective", "post-mortem", "lessons learned", or ask to review a sprint, milestone, or project.

say_en.text: Run a post-mortem for this sprint.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the GDC format analysis.

say_en.text: Review our kill list for this milestone.
say_en.note: Claude will evaluate each cut feature's correctness.

say_en.text: Analyze core loop validation for this project.
say_en.note: Claude will apply one of the six game development lenses.
